name: Tabuchi Ryouichi
source:
A mechanic friend of Pollon’s; 18 years old.

Dub, as he’s also called, joins in on gravbike street races with Pollon. He’s the son of the Tabuchi Motors auto repair shop’s manager.

[From [url=https://www.kirikiribasara.com/2022/06/08/anonymouscode-character-profile-translations/]Kiri Kiri Basara[/url]]
